name: Fabric Extensibility Toolkit - Workload Self-Service Publishing (Selected audience)
description: **Workload Self-Service Publishing to selected audience**ISVs can now self‑service publish workloads built with the [Fabric Extensibility Toolkit](https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/extensibility-toolkit/extensibility-toolkit-overview) into Selected Audience (private preview). This capability allows publishers to reserve a WorkloadName directly by uploading their manifest through the Fabric Admin Portal—removing the previous dependency on the Microsoft team to pre‑register the name.In addition, publishers can now publish their workloads to up to 20 external tenants for early testing and validation.**Key Capabilities**Self‑service registration – Reserve a workload ID and publish workloads end‑to‑end through the portal.
